note: Source for scripts/Build-GestureAssets.mjs (docs/COMPANION_GESTURES.md). Each talk family becomes one workspot (idle loop + one sequence per clip) and one component on the device entity. Clips are discovered from the family animsets by prefix, categorised by name, and kept only when in place (no motion extraction) and not banned. Idle workspots listed in 'propIdles' put a prop in the companion's hand (cigarette, glasses, cup, bottle); the controller starts one only with a free hand slot and takes the prop out of the slot when the idle is over (Round 11).

generic.note: Fallback for every companion whose record is not in 'characters' (the tier-2 and named contacts, any model-only copy). The controller reads the copy's body type once (NameToString of npc:GetBodyType, lower case without separators), takes the rig and with it the on_sides talk family (the stance loop every catalogued character uses; the gang idle_stand loop of woman_sides drifted 15 px over the enter blend on Blue Moon, live Oct 11) and a random pick among the rig's clean idles. 'idles' is that pool; with 'mix' it is also added to every catalogued character's own idle, so nobody has one idle only. Body types not listed (ManFat, ManMassive, mechs, animals, anything unreadable) get nothing. 'never' lists records the catalog deliberately leaves out whatever their body type reads as: Adam Smasher (man_massive) and Dexter (the man_fat rig has no talk families), Round 5.

propIdles.note: Idle workspots whose clips put a prop in the companion's hand (the engine does it: a workEquipItemToSlotAction in a clip's WorkspotItem event or in the workspot's initialActions; the item is despawned by the workspot's own item policy). The controller only starts one when the hand slot is free, looks once at the slot after the idle began, and takes the declared item out of the slot when the idle is over (mod/companion-gestures.lua, mod/gesture-workspot.lua clearSlot). 'items' is read from the animation data by scripts/Audit-PropIdles.mjs (item record and slot, the clip event that equips it); the build only checks the shape. johnny_smoke was the 'experimental' idle of Round 4 (prop cleanup unverified); it is a prop idle with a cleanup now.

johnny_smoke.equip: johnny__stand__lh_cigarette__aggressive__01 frame 0 (cig_equip); ember_passive effect on the item, smoke effects on the puff clips

idleOptions.note: Per idle workspot build options. omitClips: break clips removed from the copy (a clip the rig's animsets do not carry would stall the workspot; the audit names them). endless: the sequence does not repeat by itself (a few break clips, then the workspot leaves through its own exit while the controller still thinks it plays), so its break list is set to a clip count that is never reached and the sequence repeats, as for the seats.

conversationFit.note: Oct 9 audit (Judy feedback: pointing that made no sense). Each clip is classified for conversation: centred (moving hands stay in front of the body, between hips and chest), neutral, or excluded as directional (pointing, indicating a side, behind or across), turn (torso or head turned away from V) or sweep (broad or overhead arms). Name rules first, then the measured shape (assets/gestures/clip-shape.json, scripts/Measure-GestureShape.py) on every rig that has the clip; excluded clips keep their workspot sequence (the probe can still play them) but never play in conversation.
names: indicates off to a side or behind (by name)
flicks the head toward a side (by name)
